task_completion.description: Navigate to the Employees or Departments section in Odoo.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Odoo dashboard with the 'Employees' app open, or a list view of employees/departments.

task_completion.description: Identify employees currently assigned to 'R&D USA'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a filtered list of employees where the 'Department' column shows 'R&D USA' (e.g., Robert Miller or Anita Oliver).

task_completion.description: Change the department of all 'R&D USA' employees to 'Research & Development'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the employee form view for 'R&D USA' staff being edited, with the 'Department' field updated to 'Research & Development', and the change being saved.

task_completion.description: Verify that no employees remain in 'R&D USA'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a search or filter for 'Department: R&D USA' returning no results or showing 0 employees.
The VLM should see the 'R&D USA' department configuration page, the 'Action' menu being clicked, and the 'Archive' option selected, or an 'Archived' ribbon appearing on the record.

integrity.description: The agent should not use the terminal to execute SQL queries or python scripts to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots should show interactions with the Odoo web interface, not a command-line interface or code editor.

integrity.description: The agent interacts with the dropdowns and buttons rather than just navigating to a final URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the cursor or focus on Odoo UI elements like the 'Department' dropdown and 'Action' menu.

integrity.description: The agent should not simply delete the department; it must be archived as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Archive' action being selected, not the 'Delete' action.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source department is 'R&D USA' and the target department is 'Research & Development'. Key employees to look for in 'R&D USA' before the transfer include Robert Miller (synthetic) and Anita Oliver (demo data). To archive a department in Odoo 17, the agent must go to Employees -> Configuration -> Departments, select 'R&D USA', and use the 'Archive' option under the 'Action' gear/button.
